name: ielts-platform-root
description: Root package runner for IELTS AI Mentor Platform

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix agent
scripts.dev: npx -y concurrently -n "frontend,backend,agent" -c "cyan,magenta,yellow" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:agent"
